Type: dresser
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Glenwood Industrial Metal Dresser, 60"W, Oak
Colors: Brown
Materials: Metal
This industrial double dresser features robust metal pulls on its six drawers and a matching metal piece on the bottom. Solid hardwood construction is finished with quarter-sawn oak veneer and wire-brushed for a distressed look. 60"W x 19"D x 35"H Solid hardwood with oak veneer and metal drawer pulls A bold industrial design is softened by a classic wood finish to blend with modern décor. Self-closing drawers are suspended on concealed ball-bearing extension glides. No assembly needed. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
